description: Presidential Secretariat - An Essential Public Service for the Supply of Electricity and distribution of Petroleum Products and Fuel
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President using powers under the Essential Public Services Act (No. 61 of 1979) to declare certain services as essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
